capabilities: Preview and restyle Markdown notes with built-in or custom themes
Copy styled article HTML to the WeChat editor
Push articles with local and remote images to WeChat Official Account drafts
Generate article images from image-prompt annotations via APIMart
Crop article covers to a fixed 2.35:1 ratio and upload as PNG
extras: Publishing only creates drafts and never group-sends articles. Math formulas are rendered via CodeCogs images, sending formula content to that service. Credentials are stored in data.json; the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wants WeChat Official Account content production to return to writing itself, handling styling and draft push inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to format Markdown for WeChat Official Accounts' editor or push posts to their draft box.

relations.evidence: 预览、排版、复制并推送 Markdown 到微信公众号
APIMart 图片生成 | 通过 image-prompt 注释生成配图，支持编辑提示词、查看进度和重新生成

summary: WeChat Official Account publisher that previews, styles, and copies or pushes Markdown notes as drafts, with custom themes, image generation, and cover cropping.
